title: Cramming a Data Center into One Cabinet, a Co-Exploration of Computing and Hardware Architecture of Waferscale Chip
problem: Current wafer-scale data center architectures waste integration density due to uncoordinated resource allocation between compute and memory dies, and lack co-optimization of system area across chiplet configurations, preventing optimal performance within physical and cost constraints.
motivation: Wafer-scale chips integrate thousands of compute units on a single wafer and can extend Moore's Law at system level for LLM workloads, but their design space is too large for manual optimization without automated cross-layer co-exploration.
method: The paper develops a wafer-scale single-cabinet data center model with configurable on-chip memory dies and a vertically stacked hardware architecture. On this model, Titan is an automated exploration framework that establishes parameter dependencies between intra-chip (tile sizing, SRAM capacity) and inter-chip (die-to-die interconnect, stacking) design variables. Titan integrates vertical area constraints, physical limit pre-checks, and a suite of reliability prediction models to prune infeasible configurations and accelerate the design cycle.
key_novelty: An automated co-exploration framework (Titan) that jointly optimizes computing architecture (parallelism strategy, operator mapping) and hardware architecture (chiplet layout, memory stacking) for wafer-scale systems under physical and reliability constraints.
contributions: Optimized wafer-scale single-cabinet data center model with configurable memory dies and vertical stacking
Titan automated framework for intra-chip and inter-chip co-design and optimization
Vertical area constraint formulation with physical limit pre-checks to reduce design cycle time
Integration of reliability prediction models into the wafer-scale design exploration loop

metrics.other: integration density and cost metrics; specific numbers not given in abstract

limitations: Manufacturing yield implications of wafer-scale integration and the cost of defect mitigation are not detailed in the abstract.
primary_theme: wafer-scale chip co-exploration for LLM data centers
